CaseStudies.title: Transforming Event Management for Island Strength & Power
body: **Industry:** Sports & Recreation | Non-Profit Organization | eCommerce & Event Management
## Client Overview

**Island Strength & Power (ISP)** is a Prince Edward Island-based non-profit organization dedicated to growing the sports of Strongman and Powerlifting. As the provincial affiliate of Strongman Canada Corporation (SCC) and World Raw Powerlifting Federation (WRPF) Canada, ISP hosts competitions, promotes athlete development, and provides opportunities for strength athletes across the Island.
As the organization continued to gain recognition and attract more competitors, the administrative processes that once worked well began to limit its growth.
## The Challenge

Like many growing organizations, Island Strength & Power started with simple, low-cost tools to manage event registrations. Athletes completed Google Forms while registration fees were collected separately through Interac e-Transfer.
Although this process was sufficient in the early stages, it quickly became inefficient as participation increased.
The organizing team faced several recurring challenges:
* Matching e-Transfer payments with submitted registration forms
* Following up with athletes who had registered but not yet paid
* Manually tracking registrations in spreadsheets
* Spending valuable volunteer time on administrative work instead of event planning
* Providing athletes with a registration experience that reflected the professionalism of the organization
The registration process had become fragmented, creating unnecessary work for organizers while increasing the possibility of human error.
Island Strength & Power needed a solution that could streamline administration today while supporting future growth.
## Our Solution
Avanti Insieme designed and implemented a modern, scalable website that serves as both a marketing platform and a centralized event management system.
Rather than creating a simple informational website, we developed a custom Content Management System (CMS) integrated directly with Stripe for secure online payments.
The new platform allows the ISP team to manage events from one centralized location while providing athletes with a seamless registration experience.
### Key Features Delivered
* Event creation and management through an easy-to-use administrative dashboard
* Online athlete registration
* Secure payment processing using Stripe
* Automated collection of registration information
* Exportable participant spreadsheets for event planning and weigh-ins
* Centralized management of registrations and payments
* Mobile-friendly website accessible on any device
Because the solution was built with scalability in mind, the platform can continue evolving alongside the organization as its needs change.
## The Results
The impact of the new platform extended beyond simply replacing forms and e-transfers.
Island Strength & Power now operates with a streamlined registration process that reduces administrative overhead while improving the experience for both organizers and athletes.
Some of the immediate improvements include:
* A single location where athletes can discover events, register, and pay online
* Elimination of manual payment reconciliation between forms and e-Transfers
* Faster access to accurate participant information
* Improved professionalism and credibility through a dedicated online presence
* Reduced administrative workload for volunteers and event organizers

Instead of spending hours matching payments and maintaining spreadsheets, organizers can now focus on delivering exceptional competitions and growing the strength community across Prince Edward Island.
## Measuring Success
While every project has unique objectives, several indicators demonstrate the success of this implementation.
### Improved User Experience
Athletes now have one clear destination for event information and registration, eliminating confusion about where to sign up.
### Streamlined Administration
Registration and payment information are collected in one integrated system, significantly reducing manual administrative work.
### Increased Online Visibility
The new website provides Island Strength & Power with a professional digital presence that makes it easier for athletes, sponsors, and prospective members to discover the organization.
### Foundation for Growth
Perhaps the greatest success is that the platform is no longer just a website—it has become the operational foundation upon which future services can be built.
## Looking Ahead
One of Avanti Insieme's guiding principles is building solutions that continue creating value long after launch.
The Island Strength & Power platform was intentionally designed to support future expansion without requiring a complete rebuild.
Planned enhancements include:
* A refreshed user interface with an even stronger focus on usability and search engine optimization (SEO)
* Expanded eCommerce capabilities to sell branded merchandise directly through the website
* Online coaching and training programs with secure digital purchases
* Athlete profiles and performance history maintained directly within the platform
* Digital competition records and rankings to replace external spreadsheets
* Additional automation tools to further simplify event administration
These enhancements will allow Island Strength & Power to increase revenue opportunities while continuing to improve the experience for athletes and volunteers alike.
## Conclusion
Technology should simplify operations—not create more work.

By replacing disconnected tools with an integrated event management platform, Avanti Insieme helped Island Strength & Power transition from manual administration to a scalable digital solution built for long-term growth.
Today, the organization has a professional online presence, a streamlined registration process, secure online payments, and a platform capable of supporting future expansion.
Whether it's managing competitions, generating new revenue streams, or improving the athlete experience, the website has become a valuable asset that grows alongside the organization.
At Avanti Insieme, we believe the best software doesn't just solve today's problems—it creates opportunities for tomorrow.
